scope: codifies canonical validator rejection logic for AL membrane enforcement

rules.rule: A receipt has zero canonical authority unless its hash appears in _truth/receipts/index.json with valid signatures. Public visibility, repository presence, or social proof must not be treated as authority.
Verify signatures against the epoch-0 keyset active at issued_at, using ed25519 and sha256.
When promotion threshold is 1_of_1_bootstrap, allow only boundary_receipts, keyset_publication, validator_policy_receipts, and repo_hygiene_receipts.

Reject any promotion matching forbidden_scope, including Epoch 4 experimental claim promotion, OpenAI legitimacy claims, RED_TO_GREEN narrative elevation, visual art as truth, or universal canonical supremacy.
Objects with ClaimDraft schema or WK keys are syntactically invalid for index.json.
Drafts not indexed, including this policy until indexed, have zero canonical effect.
Experimental promotion stays blocked until a keyset rotation to m_of_n is indexed.
